title: Is this $450 laptop from an unknown brand too good to be true?
summary: Chinese brand Chuwi announced a $450 Windows laptop with aluminum build and Intel's new Wildcat Lake processor, undercutting the MacBook Neo's $699 price point. However, the reviewer concludes it's too good to be true, indicating significant trade-offs in performance or build quality.
content:
Cute name, especially if it were a wookiee. | Photo: Antonio G. Di Benedetto / The Verge	

Finding a good laptop under $500 was hard enough before RAMageddon. They nearly always had cheap hardware and underpowered, often outdated chips. That's what made the MacBook Neo so disruptive: It offered great build quality and good-enough performance starting at $599. Windows laptops couldn't touch it. Even though it's gone up to $699, it's still the laptop to beat.
So when little-known Chinese brand Chuwi announced a $450 Windows laptop with an aluminum build and a brand-new Intel Wildcat Lake processor, it sounded too good to be true.
It is.

title: The first self-driving vehicle on Mars has proven to be a smashing success
summary: NASA's Perseverance rover has successfully demonstrated autonomous navigation on Mars, with approximately 90 percent of its total driving distance completed without human control. This achievement validates self-driving technology for extraterrestrial exploration.
content: About 90 percent of the distance driven by Perseverance has been autonomous.

zh.title: 火星上第一辆自驾车已被证明是巨大的成功
zh.summary: 美国航空航天局的毅力号火星车已成功演示了火星上的自主导航，约90%的总行驶距离在没有人类控制的情况下完成。这一成就验证了自驾车技术在地外探索中的应用。

title: DeepMind’s hurricane breakthrough has surprised weather scientists
summary: DeepMind's open-source WeatherNext model can generate accurate hurricane predictions using lower-resolution weather data than traditional forecasting methods. The breakthrough has surprised meteorologists and could expand access to advanced weather prediction technology.
content: Open source WeatherNext model can make accurate predictions with lower-resolution weather data.

zh.title: DeepMind的飓风突破让气象学家感到惊讶
zh.summary: DeepMind的开源WeatherNext模型能够使用比传统预报方法更低分辨率的天气数据生成准确的飓风预测。这一突破令气象学家感到意外，有望扩大先进天气预报技术的使用范围。

title: Nitecore’s latest power bank is the lightest and most compact yet
summary: The Nitecore NB10000 Gen 4 is the lightest and most compact 10,000mAh power bank available, weighing just 146 grams with minimal dimensions. At $83.95, it's purpose-built for backpackers and endurance athletes seeking to minimize gear weight.
content:
The Nitecore NB10000 Gen 4 power bank is a great option for endurance athletes and backpackers. | Photo by Thomas Ricker / The Verge	

There's two things you should know about me, your intrepid reviewer: I hate the feature creep associated with modern power banks, and I love shaving grams off the gear I carry when backpacking,  bikepacking, and trail running. So imagine my delight when Nitecore released a new generation of its ultralight NB10000 battery. After a few weeks with it I can confidently say: Haribo be damned!
The $83.95 NB10000 Gen 4 weighs just 146 grams, according to my scale, and measures 1.45 x 11.6 x 4.68cm (0.57 x 4.57 x 1.84 inches), according to Nitecore's spec sheet. That makes it the lightest and most compact 10,000mAh power bank I can find. Even when  …
